p: It's broken down into easy steps, in the order you need them. There's a lot of information here, and anyone considering a property investment in the North West of England should take the time to read it. It boils down decades of UK property investment experience, several years of buying, selling and investing in Greater Manchester ourselves, and many hours of research by our team and founders, pulling together market reports, government documents and property data.
So take your time. By the end you'll fully understand not only Oldham Street Lofts, but the wider case for Hyde and Manchester's commuter belt.

faq: Book a video call and choose your loft with Charlie. £3,500 then takes it off the market: £3,000 is your reservation deposit and counts towards your 20% deposit, and £500 is BRIK Studios' admin fee.
What do I pay, and when?
£3,500 to reserve. The rest of your 20% deposit on exchange, plus legal fees. The balance on completion, expected mid 2027, usually with a 75% buy-to-let mortgage.
What's the lease and ground rent?
A 999-year lease with a peppercorn ground rent.
£2.50 per sq ft per year, about £87 a month for an average one bed. There's no lift, lounge or gym in the building, which keeps it lean.
Where is the build up to?
Planning was granted by Tameside Council on 23 April 2025, reference 24/00783/FUL. The build is under way, with the frame and blockwork going up, and completion is expected mid 2027.
Yes, an ABC+ build warranty, accepted by most major lenders.

We estimate £900 to £950 a month: £925 for a standard one bed and £950 for the larger corner lofts, let furnished. A lender's valuer will usually assess rent against unfurnished stock, so plan to borrow on a lower figure. Our estimates are not a formal rental valuation.
Who looks after it once it's finished?
We do: tenant find, referencing, rent collection and day-to-day management, for 10% of the rent, which is already in the numbers in this report. You don't need to live nearby.
Once the last lease is granted, the freehold passes to a management company owned by the apartment buyers.
